translations.text: Come now and have mercy, ruler of powers, and grant us your kingdom, righteous judge: the best of dwellings and eternal life, where we will find peace and love together,
just as those in the heavens, noble and eternal, ever thank you for your high majesty. Christ's pure and chosen thanes sing, and ask the true God for grace and forgiveness for all peoples;
your Father's kingdom, which was fairly prepared in the beginning, the best of dwellings and eternal life, if we always carry out truth and right.
Give us today, Lord, your mercy and powers, and bend our mind, our thoughts and our conduct, to your will.

And do not let the hateful ones deceive us in temptation, or kill and burn our souls, though through our folly we have committed many sins by day and by night, idle speech and wrongful deeds, and have broken your commandments.
We praise and glorify you, true God, since you, Saviour, are made known as the royal child to the living and the dead, noble and eternal above all things.
